notes.title: YIIK I.V OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
At long last, YIIK I.V (version 1.5) is available! We want to thank all of you for your patience and interest in the update. We've poured our hearts and souls into this and hope you enjoy what we've created.

For those of you who haven't been keeping up, here’s what's new:

[list]
[*] A whole new battle mode.
[*] A new playable protagonist, the Nameless Child.
[*] Over 10 new areas to explore.
[*] An improved Mind Dungeon for a more engaging leveling-up experience.
[*] Recreated cutscenes and brand new story elements.
[*] So many surprises there aren’t enough bullet points to get it across.
[/list]

This update is huge!

It's available for free to all owners of YIIK: A Postmodern RPG.
